title: Moove raises $250M to become the backbone of the robotaxi industry | TechCrunch
summary: Moove’s evolution from a vehicle financing startup to ride-hailing and deliveries in Africa to one that also owns autonomous vehicles may seem like a leap. It owns and operates a 42,000-vehicle ride-hailing fleet across 14 countries.
